description:
Converts a PADS PowerPCB ASCII file (.asc, first line "!PADS-POWERPCB…") into the standard schematic schema, using the board's real connectivity — no transcription from images.

The .asc file has no component values, so pass the BOM (bomPath: .xlsx, legacy .xls, or a comma/tab-separated text BOM with a Reference/Designator column and a Value/Part/Comment column; NC/DNP values count as not fitted). Parts on the PCB but missing from the BOM are treated as not fitted and removed (listed in notFitted — check it: connectors or headers left out of a BOM show up there).
Part types are inferred from the reference prefix (U→ic, C→cap, R→res, L→ind …) and the BOM value; mcu.family is left empty — add it (stm32f4|stm32f1|esp32|numicro) before calling embedcalc_review_schematic.
Without a BOM, resistor/inductor values are unknown, so 0Ω links and beads are not followed and parts behind them can be missed. Parts with no connection in the PCB file (mounting holes, fiducials) are dropped.

Returns { schematic, notFitted[], bomOnly[], netsOnlyToNotFitted[] }. netsOnlyToNotFitted = nets dropped because only one pin was left after removing not-fitted parts (e.g. an MCU pin that only went to an unfitted header). Net names are the PCB's names, which can differ from the schematic labels.

bomPath.description: Absolute path of the BOM (.xlsx, .xls or .csv/.txt). Strongly recommended: without it values and fitted/not-fitted status are unknown

path.description: Absolute path of the PADS ASCII file (.asc)

name: embedcalc_parse_pads
title: Parse PADS PCB + BOM
